title: Crispy Air-Fried Calamari Rings (No Deep Frying)
ingredients: 14 oz calamari rings, fresh or thawed
Salt and lemon wedges for serving
description: Golden, crispy calamari rings in just 8 minutes! Discover the semolina secret for a perfect crust and tender inside, using a fraction of the oil compared to deep frying.
instructions: Thoroughly dry the calamari rings with paper towels.
Combine calamari rings and semolina flour in a sealable plastic bag. Shake vigorously to ensure an even coating.
Remove the calamari from the bag, tapping off excess flour. Arrange them in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Generously spray the calamari with olive oil, ensuring no dry flour is visible.
Cook at 390°F for 8-10 minutes. Shake the basket at the halfway point of the cooking time.
tip: Use remilled durum wheat semolina flour to achieve the characteristic texture of traditional Italian fried seafood.
big_image_prompt: Crispy golden fried calamari rings (anelli di calamari) served in a paper cone or rustic bowl with fresh lemon wedges. High quality seafood photography, macro details of the semolina crust, bright lighting.

title: Perfect Air Fryer Breaded Cutlet (Fail-Proof Crust)
description: Crispy, golden breaded cutlet without deep frying. Discover the trick for breading that sticks and juicy meat in just 12 minutes. The time-saving dinner kids love!
instructions: Pound the cutlets to an even thickness if necessary.
Season the beaten egg with salt and pepper. Dip each cutlet into the egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs, pressing firmly to adhere.
Preheat the appliance to 375°F (190°C).
Coat the appliance basket with cooking spray. Place the cutlets in the basket and spray their top surfaces.
Cook for 12-15 minutes. Halfway through cooking, flip the cutlets and spray the other side.
tip: For enhanced flavor, add 1 tablespoon of grated Parmesan cheese and half a minced garlic clove to the breadcrumbs.
big_image_prompt: A classic Italian 'fettina panata' (breaded chicken cutlet) golden and crispy, served on a white plate with a side of mixed green salad and a lemon slice. Natural bright lighting, appetizing.

title: Stuffed Meatloaf (Melty Cheese Center)
ingredients: 1.1 lbs mixed ground meat (beef and pork)
3.5 oz provola or scamorza cheese, sliced
Extra virgin olive oil, for brushing
description: Stuffed meatloaf with a melting cheese heart and perfect crust in 35 minutes. No need to run the oven for an hour: the foolproof recipe for a moist and juicy meat main course.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground meat, egg, Parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper. Mix until a firm, uniform mixture is achieved.
On a sheet of parchment paper, press the meat mixture into a rectangle approximately 1/2-inch thick.
Layer the ham and cheese slices over the meat, leaving a 1-inch border on all sides.
Using the parchment paper as a guide, tightly roll the meat into a loaf. Pinch the seam and ends to seal completely.

Brush the exterior of the meatloaf with olive oil and place rosemary sprigs on top. Transfer to the air fryer basket, placing it on a perforated parchment sheet. Cook at 355°F for 35-40 minutes, or until cooked through.
tip: Allow the meatloaf to rest for 10 minutes after cooking before slicing. This prevents the slices from crumbling.
big_image_prompt: A hearty Italian stuffed meatloaf (polpettone) sliced open, revealing a melted cheese and ham center. Placed on a wooden cutting board with fresh rosemary sprigs and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Diced Sausage and Potatoes (Quick One-Pan Meal)
description: Sausage and potatoes: the time-saving one-pan meal ready in just 20 minutes. Extra-crispy golden potatoes and juicy sausage perfectly degreased thanks to the hot air flow.
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1-inch (2-3 cm) cubes. Soak in cold water for 10 minutes, then dry thoroughly.
Cut sausage into 2-inch (5 cm) chunks.
In a bowl, combine potatoes, sausage, garlic, rosemary, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mix until evenly coated.
Arrange the mixture in a single layer in the cooking basket. Cook at 385°F (195°C) for 20-25 minutes.
Shake the basket every 7-8 minutes to ensure even cooking and browning.
tip: Ensure potatoes are cut into uniform cubes to promote even cooking. Larger pieces may not cook through completely.
big_image_prompt: A rustic Italian dish of roasted sausage chunks and golden diced potatoes (salsiccia e patate) with fresh rosemary sprigs, served in a black cast iron skillet. Hearty, warm, home-cooked meal.

title: Abruzzese Lamb Skewers (Charcoal Grill Effect in Air Fryer)
description: Succulent Abruzzese lamb skewers cooked to perfection in just 8 minutes! Discover how to get a fantastic charcoal grill effect right in your home, smoke-free while rendering the fat.
instructions: If skewers are too long for the cooking basket, break or cut the wooden ends.
Arrange skewers in the basket in a maximum of two crossed layers.
Cook at 400°F for 8-10 minutes.
Flip skewers halfway through cooking.
Remove skewers, place in aluminum foil, and season with salt. Seal the foil and rest for one minute before serving.
tip: Add salt only after cooking to prevent the meat from losing moisture and becoming tough.
big_image_prompt: A bundle of authentic Abruzzese arrosticini (lamb skewers) served on a rustic wooden table with slices of homemade bread and a glass of red wine. Charcoal grilled look, juicy meat, dark dramatic lighting.

title: Jewish-Style Artichokes (Extra Crispy Without Deep Frying)
ingredients: Fine sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: Super crispy Jewish-style artichokes without plunging into boiling oil. Shatteringly crisp leaves and a tender heart ready in 15 minutes: the delicious Roman side dish without the fried smell at home.
instructions: Remove the tough outer leaves from the artichokes. Trim the fibrous part of the stem.
Tap the artichokes upside down on a cutting board to open the leaves.
Coat the artichokes with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Ensure seasoning penetrates between the leaves.
Place the artichokes upside down in the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F (180°C) for 10 minutes.
Turn the artichokes upright. Cook for an additional 5 minutes at 400°F (200°C) until the leaves are crisp.
tip: To prevent oxidation after cleaning, submerge the artichokes in acidulated water.
big_image_prompt: Roasted artichokes opened like flowers (carciofi alla giudia) with crispy golden-brown leaves and a tender heart. Served on a dark slate plate with coarse salt and a drizzle of olive oil. Elegant food photography.

title: Gratinated Stuffed Vegetables (Rice & Meat in 20 Mins)
description: Gratinated stuffed vegetables in just 20 minutes! Tomatoes and peppers with a fragrant filling and  crust. The super easy one-pan meal that elegantly empties the fridge.
instructions: Cut the tops off the tomatoes and bell peppers. Remove the seeds. Blend the pulp from the tomatoes.
Combine the uncooked rice or ground meat with the blended tomato pulp, olive oil, salt, grated Parmesan cheese, and chopped basil.
Fill the vegetables three-quarters full to allow for rice expansion. Replace the vegetable tops or sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Arrange the stuffed vegetables in the cooking basket.
Cook at 355°F (180°C) for 20-25 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the filling is cooked through.
tip: When using uncooked rice, ensure the filling has a high moisture content by adding sufficient liquid, such as the blended tomato pulp, to guarantee the rice cooks completely.
big_image_prompt: Italian stuffed vegetables, red tomatoes and bell peppers filled with savory rice and herbs, roasted to perfection. Served in a rustic baking dish, garnished with fresh basil leaves.

title: Rosemary Diced Potatoes (Golden Without Parboiling)
description: Golden, extra-crispy diced potatoes on the outside, tender inside in 20 minutes. Discover the foolproof trick (no parboiling) for perfect sides with minimal effort and zero heavy fats.
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 3/4 to 1-inch cubes. Rinse cubes under cold water to remove excess starch. Dry thoroughly with a kitchen towel.
In a large bowl, combine potato cubes, olive oil, crushed unpeeled garlic cloves, and rosemary needles. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the seasoned potatoes in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Cook at 385°F for 20 minutes.
Shake the basket every 6-7 minutes to ensure even cooking. Season with salt after cooking.
tip: Leaving the garlic cloves unpeeled prevents them from burning and developing a bitter taste during cooking.
big_image_prompt: Perfectly roasted Italian diced potatoes (patate al forno) with golden crispy edges, mixed with fresh rosemary sprigs and whole garlic cloves. Served in a terracotta bowl on a wooden surface.

title: Ricotta & Spinach Savory Pie (Ultra-Crispy Pastry)
ingredients: 1 round sheet puff or shortcrust pastry
description: Ricotta and spinach savory pie with ultra-crispy puff pastry in just 20 minutes. Avoid a soggy bottom: discover the air frying technique for well-cooked, golden pastries without turning on the oven.
instructions: Thoroughly squeeze excess moisture from the cooked spinach and chop finely. In a mixing bowl, combine the chopped spinach with ricotta, egg, grated Parmesan, salt, and nutmeg.
Unroll the pastry sheet on its parchment paper. Line a round baking dish with the pastry and parchment.
Prick the base of the pastry with a fork. Pour the filling into the pastry shell and level the surface.
Fold the excess pastry edges inward over the filling.
Bake at 340°F for 20-25 minutes. If the edges brown excessively, shield them with aluminum foil during the final 5 minutes of cooking.
tip: To ensure a crisp pastry base, place the baking dish on a perforated rack to allow for optimal air circulation underneath.
big_image_prompt: A slice of savory Italian Ricotta and Spinach tart (Torta salata) with a flaky, buttery golden crust. Displayed on a rustic plate with a checkered napkin in the background. Natural daylight.

title: Perfect Roasted Chestnuts (Easy to Peel in 15 Mins)
description: Perfect roasted chestnuts in 15 minutes with no smoke in the house! Discover the foolproof trick (soaking) to get chestnuts soft inside with skins that peel off in a second.
instructions: Score each chestnut horizontally on its rounded side with a sharp knife.
Soak the chestnuts in warm water for a minimum of 15 minutes to soften the peel.
Drain the chestnuts and dry them thoroughly with a kitchen towel.
Arrange the chestnuts in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook at 390°F for 15-20 minutes, depending on size.
Remove the chestnuts from the air fryer and wrap them in a damp cloth. Let rest for 5 minutes to facilitate peeling.
tip: Soaking the chestnuts and resting them in a damp cloth are crucial steps to ensure proper moisture and ease of peeling.
big_image_prompt: Professional food photography of roasted chestnuts (caldarroste) in a rustic wooden bowl, some partially peeled showing the golden fruit inside. Cozy autumn lighting, steam rising, macro detail, rustic dark wood table.

title: Arancini & Supplì (Melty Heart, No Fried Smell)
description: The king of street food gets a light makeover! Golden arancini and supplì with an extra-crispy crust and a melty mozzarella heart. Air-fried in 15 minutes with no fried smell.
instructions: Cook arancini or supplì directly from the refrigerator to help maintain their shape.
Coat the entire breaded surface with cooking spray to ensure even browning and prevent dryness.
Arrange them in a single layer in the cooking basket, ensuring they do not touch.
Cook at 390°F for 15-18 minutes.
Halfway through cooking, turn the arancini or supplì. Apply a light spray of oil to any dry spots on the breading.
tip: For homemade preparations, use a slurry of flour and water as a binder before breading. This creates a more durable and crispier crust.
big_image_prompt: A mouth-watering shot of Italian Arancini (stuffed rice balls), one broken in half revealing melted mozzarella stringing out and red tomato ragù inside. Golden crispy breadcrumb exterior, served on a rustic tile.

title: Potato Croquettes (Golden Panzarotti, No Falling Apart)
ingredients: 1.1 lbs (500g) cold mashed potatoes (from starchy potatoes)
4 oz (115g) mozzarella cheese, well-drained and cubed
Salt and black pepper to taste
description: Light and perfectly golden potato croquettes (panzarotti). Avoid them falling apart during cooking: discover how to get a sturdy shell and a melty mozzarella heart in 12 mins.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cold mashed potatoes, 1 large egg, and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Mix until fully incorporated.
Take a portion of the potato mixture and shape it into a cylinder. Insert a cube of mozzarella into the center and seal completely.
Coat each croquette first in the beaten egg, then roll it in breadcrumbs, ensuring complete coverage.
Refrigerate the coated croquettes for a minimum of 15 minutes to firm them.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Arrange croquettes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, ensuring they do not touch.
Lightly spray the croquettes with cooking spray. Bake for 12-14 minutes, turning them halfway through the cooking time, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: To prevent bursting, use starchy, low-moisture potatoes. Ensure the mashed potatoes are completely cold and dry before use.
big_image_prompt: Italian potato croquettes (crocchè di patate) on a wooden board. Golden brown crispy exterior, one croquette is pulled apart showing fluffy mashed potato and gooey melted mozzarella cheese. Rustic lighting.

title: Quick Focaccia Flatbread (Thin, Salty & Crispy in 12 Mins)
description: Crispy focaccia (schiacciatina) in 12 minutes! Discover the brine trick to cook store-bought dough, making it thin, golden, and fragrant without turning on the traditional oven.
instructions: Cut a circle of parchment paper to fit the baking surface. Grease with olive oil.
Place the dough on the parchment paper. Use fingertips to spread and create dimples on the surface.
In a small bowl, whisk 2 tablespoons of olive oil with 1 tablespoon of water to create an emulsion.
Pour the emulsion over the dough. Sprinkle with coarse salt and rosemary.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 12-15 minutes, until the surface is golden brown and crisp.
tip: The oil and water emulsion prevents the dough from drying out during baking, ensuring a soft interior.
big_image_prompt: A freshly baked Italian flatbread (Schiacciatina/Focaccia) glistening with olive oil, dimpled with fingerprints, topped with coarse sea salt and fresh rosemary. Rustic bakery style.

title: Filled Puff Pastry Croissants (Hot Breakfast in 10 Mins)
ingredients: Chocolate-hazelnut spread, pistachio cream, or jam, for filling
1 egg yolk or milk, for wash
description: Cafe-style breakfast at home in 10 minutes. Hot puff pastry croissants, filled and golden in the air fryer. Super fast to prepare to start the day with a smile.
instructions: Unroll the puff pastry sheet and cut it into 8 equal triangular wedges.
Place one teaspoon of filling at the base of each triangle.
Roll each triangle from the base to the tip. Curve the ends to create a croissant shape.
Arrange the croissants on parchment paper in the cooking basket, ensuring they are spaced apart. Brush the surface with egg yolk or milk.
Cook at 340°F for 10-12 minutes until golden brown and puffed. Let cool before garnishing with powdered sugar.
tip: Do not overfill the croissants. The filling will liquefy during cooking and may leak, causing the pastry to tear.
big_image_prompt: Freshly baked mini Italian croissants (Cornetti di sfoglia) dusted with powdered sugar, one cut open revealing oozing chocolate hazelnut spread. Cozy breakfast table setting with a cappuccino.

title: Lighter Eggplant Parmesan (Perfect Gratin in 20 Mins)
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil, as needed
description: The real eggplant parmesan but in a lighter version! Air pre-cooked eggplants (zero pan-frying) layered with mozzarella and tomato. Chef-quality gratin in 20 mins.
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Lightly brush the eggplant slices with oil. Pre-cook in the air fryer basket at 355°F for 8 minutes.
In a small, air fryer-safe baking dish, assemble the dish by layering tomato passata, eggplant slices, cubed mozzarella, Parmesan cheese, and basil.
Bake at 355°F for 12 minutes, or until the surface is golden brown.
tip: Utilize low-moisture block mozzarella instead of fresh mozzarella to prevent excess liquid in the final dish.

title: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce (Juicy Inside, Lightly Crisp Outside)
ingredients: 10.6 oz mixed ground beef and pork
1 slice stale bread, soaked in milk and squeezed
Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: Super tender meatballs in tomato sauce with minimal effort. Discover the double-cooking method: lightly brown the meatballs in the air fryer to lock in juices, then finish them in tomato sauce. Comfort food in 15 mins.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the squeezed bread, ground meat, egg, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix until well incorporated.
Shape the mixture into meatballs, approximately 1.5 inches in diameter.
Arrange the meatballs in a single layer. Cook at 375°F for 10 minutes until sealed and browned.
Transfer the meatballs to a heatproof dish. Cover with warm tomato sauce and cook for an additional 5 minutes at the same temperature.
tip: Cooking the meatballs before adding the sauce seals the exterior, which helps retain moisture and ensures a tender result.

title: Sicilian Ragù Arancini (Crispy Golden Crust Without Deep Frying)
ingredients: 1.8 oz Caciocavallo or Provolone cheese, diced
description: The authentic cone-shaped Sicilian arancino, without plunging into oil. A thick, crispy breadcrumb crust with a warm heart of saffron rice and rich meat ragù. Sublime!
instructions: Dissolve saffron in one tablespoon of hot water. Combine with the cold rice and mix thoroughly.
Portion the rice into handfuls. Flatten one portion in your palm. Place a spoonful of ragù, peas, and a cheese cube in the center.
Enclose the filling with the rice, shaping it into a ball or cone. Prepare a thin batter with flour and water. Dip each arancino into the batter, then coat completely with breadcrumbs.
Lightly spray the arancini with olive oil. Cook at 400°F for 15 minutes, turning them over at the halfway point.
tip: Ensure the rice is thoroughly chilled. Using warm or room-temperature rice will prevent the arancini from holding their shape.

title: Ascolana Meat-Stuffed Olives (Crispy Appetizer in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 20 meat-stuffed Ascolana-style olives, fresh or frozen
description: Delicious meat-stuffed Ascolana olives: the perfect appetizer ready in 10 minutes. The hot air flow dries the breading, making it extra crispy without the grease of pan-frying.
instructions: Arrange the olives in a single layer in the cooking basket, ensuring they are spaced apart.
Spray the olives lightly and evenly with cooking oil.
Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes. Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: If using frozen olives, do not thaw. Cook directly from frozen and add 2-3 minutes to the total cooking time.

title: Ligurian-Style Stuffed Zucchini (Quick Gratin)
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: Ligurian-style stuffed zucchini boats: a delicious, protein-rich main course. Flavorful meat and golden breadcrumbs blend in a perfect gratin, cutting oven cooking times in half.
instructions: Halve the zucchini lengthwise. Scoop out the pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Finely chop the removed pulp.
In a mixing bowl, combine the chopped zucchini pulp, ground meat, egg, and grated Parmesan cheese. Season with marjoram, salt, and pepper. Mix until well incorporated.
Stuff the zucchini shells evenly with the meat mixture. Sprinkle the surface with breadcrumbs and drizzle with olive oil.
Arrange the stuffed zucchini in the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F (180°C) for 18 minutes, or until the filling is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
tip: For a softer texture, blanch the hollowed zucchini shells in boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Drain and pat dry before filling.

title: Roman Supplì 'al Telefono'
ingredients: 1.5 cups (8.8 oz) chilled cooked rice with tomato sauce or ragù
3.5 oz low-moisture mozzarella, cut into strips
description: Named for the 'telephone wire' of mozzarella that stretches when you pull them apart. These Roman rice croquettes are a savory, cheesy staple of the Eternal City.
instructions: Portion approximately two tablespoons of chilled rice. Flatten the portion in your palm and place mozzarella strips in the center.
Enclose the mozzarella with the rice, forming an oval shape.
Coat each supplì first in the beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs, ensuring complete coverage.
Spray the supplì with olive oil. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes, turning them over at the halfway point.
tip: Use low-moisture mozzarella to prevent the supplì from breaking open during cooking.

title: Mozzarella in Carrozza (Golden Fried Sandwich)
description: A Neapolitan street food classic. Thick slices of bread encase a heart of stringy mozzarella, resulting in a crispy, golden exterior and a luxuriously melted center—all with a fraction of the oil.
instructions: Remove crusts from the bread slices. Place a thick slice of mozzarella between two bread slices and press the edges firmly to seal.
Briefly dip the sealed edges of the sandwich in milk. Submerge the entire sandwich in beaten egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Apply an even coat of cooking oil spray to both sides of the sandwich.
Cook at 375°F for 10 minutes. Turn the sandwich over at the 5-minute mark to ensure even browning.
tip: For enhanced flavor, add an anchovy fillet or a slice of cooked ham with the mozzarella.

title: Meat-Stuffed Bell Peppers (Perfectly Cooked in 25 Mins)
ingredients: 2 medium bell peppers, red or yellow
1 slice white bread, soaked and squeezed dry
description: Sweet bell peppers stuffed with ground meat: the dinner-saving one-pan meal ready in 25 minutes. The hot air flow ensures soft peppers and a spectacular gratin on the filling, without turning on the oven.
instructions: Halve the bell peppers lengthwise. Remove seeds and pith.
In a mixing bowl, combine the ground meat, soaked bread, egg, parsley, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Divide the mixture evenly and stuff each pepper half.
Top the stuffed peppers with grated cheese and drizzle with olive oil.
Place the peppers in the cooking basket. Cook at 356°F (180°C) for 25 minutes, until the peppers are tender and the meat is cooked through.
tip: If the filling browns too quickly during cooking, cover the peppers with aluminum foil for the first 15 minutes.

title: Diced Sausage and Potatoes (Quick One-Pan Meal)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: The ultimate Italian comfort duo. As they roast together, the savory juices from the sausage infuse the potatoes, creating a dish with crispy edges and deep, traditional flavor in 20 minutes.
instructions: Peel and cut the potatoes into 1-inch chunks. Season with olive oil, salt, pepper, rosemary, and the whole garlic clove.
Cut the sausages into large pieces or leave whole, pricking the casing.
Arrange the potatoes and sausage in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 375°F for 22 minutes. Shake the basket every 7-8 minutes to ensure even cooking and flavor distribution.
tip: Use a minimal amount of oil on the potatoes. The fat rendered from the sausage during cooking will be sufficient to coat and flavor them.

title: Neapolitan Pasta Omelette (Frittata di Pasta)
ingredients: Extra Virgin Olive Oil, to taste
description: The genius of Italian leftovers. This golden pasta cake features a crunchy crust and a soft, cheesy interior. Perfect for picnics, lunchboxes, or a quick, satisfying dinner in 18 minutes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper. Stir in the optional diced cured meat.
Incorporate the cooked pasta, whether plain or previously dressed, into the egg mixture. Mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a pan lined with parchment paper.
Cook at 355°F for 18 minutes. Verify doneness by inserting a toothpick into the center; it should come out clean.
tip: For a more traditional flavor, increase the amount of black pepper. Deeper pans may require additional cooking time.

title: Roman-Style Crispy Artichokes
ingredients: Garlic, parsley, and fresh calamint (or mint), minced
Extra virgin olive oil, as needed
Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: Inspired by the famous Jewish-style artichokes of Rome. The outer leaves become as crunchy as chips, while the heart stays buttery and delicate. A true gourmet treat in 15 minutes.
instructions: Clean the artichokes by removing the tough outer leaves and trimming the tips. Submerge in acidulated water (water with lemon juice) to prevent oxidation.
Remove from water and dry thoroughly. Gently tap each artichoke, stem-side up, on a work surface to open the leaves.
In a small bowl, combine minced garlic, parsley, and calamint. Season the artichokes by inserting the herb mixture, salt, pepper, and olive oil between the leaves and on the outer leaves.
Arrange the artichokes, stem-side up, in the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F (180°C) for approximately 15 minutes, until outer leaves are crisp and browned.
tip: Ensure the artichokes are completely dry before cooking. Residual water will cause the artichokes to steam rather than crisp.

title: Stuffed Zucchini Blossoms with Anchovies
ingredients: 3.5 oz Fior di Latte mozzarella, well-drained
description: Delicate and elegant. These blossoms are filled with molten mozzarella and a hint of salty anchovy, then lightly breaded for a sophisticated, crispy appetizer in just 8 minutes.
instructions: Clean the zucchini blossoms by carefully removing the internal pistil. Ensure the petals remain intact.
Insert a piece of well-drained mozzarella and one anchovy fillet into each blossom. Twist the petal tips to seal.
Season the beaten egg with salt. Dip each stuffed blossom into the egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Arrange the breaded blossoms in a single layer. Coat generously with cooking spray.
Cook at 375°F for 8 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: A dry breadcrumb coating is essential for this cooking method, as liquid batters are unsuitable.

title: Classic Tomato and Basil Bruschetta
description: The taste of summer on toast. Sourdough bread is toasted to perfection and topped with a vibrant mixture of sun-ripened tomatoes, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil in 5 minutes.
instructions: Finely dice the tomatoes. In a bowl, combine with olive oil, salt, and torn basil leaves. Set aside to marinate.
Toast the bread slices at 400°F for 4-5 minutes until crisp.
Once toasted, lightly rub the surface of each warm bread slice with a raw garlic clove.
Top each slice with the tomato mixture. Serve immediately.
tip: Toast the bread separately before adding the topping. Applying the tomato mixture before toasting will result in soggy bread due to the moisture.

title: Crispy Golden Gnocchi Bites
description: Transform your gnocchi into the perfect snack. These potato bites are toasted until golden and crunchy on the outside, remaining soft and pillowy on the inside in 12 minutes.
instructions: In a bowl, combine raw gnocchi with olive oil, salt, paprika, and rosemary. Toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the seasoned gnocchi in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 400°F for 10-12 minutes. Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
Serve immediately as an appetizer. Pair with cheese fondue or marinara sauce for dipping.
tip: Use fresh, refrigerated potato gnocchi for optimal texture. Avoid using shelf-stable, dry varieties.

title: Lemon Ricotta Carnival Fritters
ingredients: 1.8 oz granulated sugar, plus additional for coating
description: A sweet Italian tradition. These 'Castagnole' are made with creamy ricotta for a cloud-like texture, scented with citrus zest and tossed in sugar while still warm. Ready in 10 minutes.
instructions: In a bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, egg, sugar, and citrus zest. Mix until well incorporated.
Add the flour and baking powder. Knead until a smooth dough forms. If the dough is too stiff, add up to 1 tablespoon of milk.
Shape the dough into small balls, approximately 1.5 inches in diameter. Lightly coat each ball with cooking oil spray.
Cook at 355°F for 10 minutes. Immediately remove the fritters and, while still hot, roll them in granulated sugar until fully coated.
tip: Coating the dough balls with oil before cooking ensures the sugar coating will adhere properly after baking.

title: Tomato and Mozzarella Panzerotti
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil, for brushing
description: The soul of Apulian street food. These savory turnovers feature a crispy, light dough filled with a classic combination of tomato and melting mozzarella cheese in just 8 minutes.
instructions: Unroll the pizza dough and cut out circles using a round cutter.
Season the tomato puree with salt and oregano. Place one teaspoon of the seasoned puree and a portion of mozzarella in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over to form a half-moon. Press the edges firmly with the tines of a fork to seal.
Lightly brush the surface of each panzerotto with olive oil. Cook at 400°F for 8 minutes, or until golden and puffed.
tip: Ensure the edges are sealed completely to prevent the filling from leaking during cooking.

title: Tall and Soft Rosemary Focaccia
ingredients: 0.18 oz Fresh Yeast (or 0.07 oz Active Dry Yeast)
description: Experience the aroma of a traditional bakery. This focaccia is tall, airy, and soft, topped with fragrant rosemary and sea salt. Ideal for sandwiches or dipping in 18 minutes.
instructions: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Add flour, oil, and salt. Knead until an elastic dough forms.
Cover the dough and let it rise for 2 hours, or until doubled in volume.
Transfer the dough to an oiled, round baking pan. Create indentations on the surface using fingertips.
Brush the surface with an emulsion of equal parts water and oil. Sprinkle with coarse salt and fresh rosemary. Bake at 340°F for 18 minutes.
tip: For large leavened goods, avoid temperatures exceeding 340°F in high-convection environments to prevent the exterior from burning before the interior is fully cooked.

title: Crispy Calamari and Shrimp Fritto Misto
ingredients: 7 oz calamari rings, fresh or thawed
Durum wheat semolina, as needed for coating
description: A lighter take on the Italian mixed fry. Calamari and shrimp are cooked to a dry, light crispness that lets the natural sweetness of the seafood shine through in 12 minutes.
instructions: Pat the calamari and shrimp completely dry with paper towels.
Place the seafood and durum wheat semolina in a plastic bag. Shake vigorously to coat evenly.
Remove the seafood from the bag, shaking off excess semolina. Arrange in a single, non-overlapping layer in the cooking basket.
Spray all surfaces of the seafood generously with oil.
Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes. Halfway through cooking, shake the basket and apply more oil spray to any dry spots of semolina.
tip: For optimal crispness, use only durum wheat semolina. Do not substitute with all-purpose flour.

title: Traditional Mixed Fried Fish (Paranza)
ingredients: 14 oz mixed small fish (e.g., anchovies, red mullet, whiting, silversides)
Durum wheat semolina flour, for dredging
Oil spray (extra virgin olive or vegetable)
description: Rustic and authentic. A selection of small, delicate fish cooked until perfectly crisp in 10 minutes. Best enjoyed whole with a generous squeeze of fresh lemon.
instructions: Rinse the fish. Gut the larger specimens; smaller fish like silversides can be left whole. Pat all fish thoroughly dry.
Dredge the fish in semolina flour, ensuring an even coating. Shake off any excess flour.
Arrange the fish in a single layer in the preheated cooking basket. Do not overcrowd the basket.
Spray the surface of the fish evenly with oil.
Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes. Halfway through cooking, carefully turn the fish with tongs. Season with salt immediately after cooking.
tip: The fish are delicate. To prevent breaking, do not shake the basket. Use silicone-tipped tongs for turning.

title: Tender Crispy Baby Squid
ingredients: Durum Wheat Semolina, as needed for dredging
description: Quick, easy, and delicious. These baby squid are cooked at high heat to ensure a crunchy coating while the meat remains incredibly tender and juicy in 8 minutes.
instructions: Ensure baby squid are thoroughly cleaned and left whole. Pat dry with paper towels.
Dredge the squid in durum wheat semolina. Shake off excess flour.
Arrange the squid in a single layer in the cooking basket. Spray evenly with cooking oil.
Cook at 400°F for 8-10 minutes. Remove once the tentacles are golden and curled.
Season with salt. Serve immediately.
tip: Monitor cooking time closely. Cooking for more than 10 minutes will result in a rubbery texture.

title: Golden Crispy Shrimp
ingredients: 10.6 oz shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on
description: Succulent shrimp with a stunning golden coating. Whether served as a party appetizer or a main course, these bites are guaranteed to disappear fast. Ready in 10 minutes.
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp, leaving the tails on. Pat thoroughly dry.
In a shallow dish, combine semolina flour, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Dredge each shrimp in the seasoned flour, ensuring an even coating and shaking off any excess.
Arrange the shrimp in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Spray the tops with cooking oil.
Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 4-5 minutes. Flip the shrimp, spray the other side with oil, and continue to cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: The addition of sweet paprika to the flour enhances flavor and contributes to a golden-red color.

title: Rustic Skin-on Fries
description: Better than the restaurant. Skin-on fries offer a deeper potato flavor and a superior crunch. We ensure they come out perfectly golden-brown every time in 18 minutes.
instructions: Place frozen fries in the basket, distributing them in an even layer.
Do not add oil; the product is pre-oiled.
Cook at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even crisping.
tip: For optimal crispness, arrange fries in a single layer.

title: Homemade Corn Tortilla Chips (Totopos)
description: Forget store-bought bags. Make your own ultra-crunchy corn tortilla chips at home—perfect for dipping into fresh salsa, guacamole, or melting under nachos in 8 minutes.
instructions: Cut each tortilla into 8 triangular wedges.
In a bowl, toss the tortilla wedges with olive oil and salt until evenly coated.
Preheat the appliance to 300°F.
Arrange the tortilla wedges in a single layer in the basket. Cook for 8 minutes.
Shake the basket at the 4-minute mark to ensure even cooking. Serve immediately or at room temperature.
tip: Avoid overcrowding the basket. Cook in multiple batches if necessary to ensure uniform crispness.

title: Paprika-Spiced Sweet Potato Fries
description: A sweet and smoky alternative to classic fries. These sweet potato batons are seasoned with a vibrant paprika blend and roasted until tender with crispy edges in 11 minutes.
instructions: Peel the sweet potatoes. Cut into batons approximately 0.6 inches thick.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato batons with oil until evenly coated.
Add salt, sweet paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and ground black pepper. Mix thoroughly to ensure all batons are evenly seasoned.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F.
Arrange the batons in a single layer in the basket. Cook for 11-15 minutes, depending on thickness.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Monitor the sweet potatoes during the final 3 minutes of cooking. Their high sugar content makes them prone to scorching.

title: Cajun-Spiced Crispy Fries
description: Bring the flavors of Louisiana to your table. These fries are tossed in a bold Cajun spice blend, delivering a satisfyingly spicy crunch with a fluffy, tender center in 20 minutes.
instructions: Cut potatoes into uniform sticks, approximately 1/4-inch thick. Submerge in cold water for at least 15-20 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain and rinse the potato sticks. Thoroughly dry them with a kitchen towel.
Preheat the appliance to 385°F (195°C).
In a large bowl, toss the dried potato sticks with oil until evenly coated.

Arrange the potato sticks in a single layer in the cooking basket. Cook at 385°F (195°C) for 20-25 minutes. Shake the basket at the halfway point and again at the three-quarter mark to ensure even cooking.
Immediately transfer the hot fries to a large bowl. Add the Cajun seasoning and toss until evenly coated.
tip: Apply the Cajun seasoning after cooking. The spices can burn and develop a bitter taste if added prior to cooking at 385°F (195°C).

title: Perfect Homemade Potato Fries
ingredients: 30 ml (2 tbsp) sunflower or olive oil
description: Master the art of the fry. By soaking the potatoes to remove excess starch, we achieve a superior level of crispness that rivals your favorite bistro fries in 25 minutes.
instructions: Cut potatoes into sticks of uniform size. Submerge in a bowl of cold water for a minimum of 20 minutes.
Drain the potatoes, rinse under cold running water, and dry completely with a clean cloth or paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine the dried potato sticks with oil, garlic powder, and paprika. Toss to coat evenly.
Preheat the cooking appliance to 195°C (383°F).
Cook for 25-28 minutes. Agitate the basket every 10 minutes to promote uniform cooking.
Season with salt immediately after cooking. Serve hot.
tip: Avoid salting the potatoes prior to cooking. Salt extracts moisture, which inhibits crisping. Season immediately after cooking is complete.

title: Crispy Crinkle Cut Fries
description: The ultimate texture for sauce lovers. The unique crinkle cut creates more surface area for maximum crunch, making them the perfect vessel for your favorite dips in 18 minutes.
instructions: Place the frozen fries into the basket.
Do not add oil. The product is pre-fried.
Cook at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Shake the basket 2-3 times during cooking to ensure even browning.
tip: For quantities exceeding 17.6 oz, increase cooking time by 3-4 minutes.

title: Southern-Style Buttermilk Fried Chicken
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
description: A true classic made lighter. A tangy buttermilk marinade ensures incredibly juicy chicken, while the seasoned flour coating air-fries to a golden, rustic crunch in 25 minutes.
instructions: Submerge chicken pieces in buttermilk. Marinate in the refrigerator for a minimum of 1.5 hours.
In a shallow dish, combine flour, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Remove chicken from marinade, allowing excess to drip off. Dredge each piece in the seasoned flour, pressing firmly to ensure a complete and even coating.
Place coated chicken on a wire rack. Let rest for 15 minutes to allow the coating to set.
Preheat the air fryer to 383°F.
Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer in the basket. Spray all surfaces generously with cooking spray until no dry flour is visible.
Cook for 25 minutes. At the halfway point, flip the chicken pieces. Apply additional cooking spray to any dry flour spots.
tip: For optimal browning, apply additional cooking spray to any visible dry flour spots during the cooking process. If buttermilk is unavailable, substitute with an equal amount of milk mixed with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.

title: Parmesan Zucchini Fries (Crispy & Quick Snack)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: Get kids to eat their veggies! Zucchini sticks breaded with breadcrumbs and Parmesan, cooked in 10 minutes. A golden, delicious vegetarian snack without boiling oil.
instructions: Cut zucchini into sticks. Remove the core if it contains excess seeds or moisture.
Set up a three-stage breading station. In the first bowl, combine flour, salt, and pepper. In the second, whisk together eggs and milk. In the third, mix breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese.

Dredge each zucchini stick in the flour mixture, shaking off any excess. Dip it into the egg wash, allowing excess to drip off. Finally, press firmly into the breadcrumb and Parmesan mixture to ensure a complete coating.
Preheat the cooking appliance to 375°F (190°C).
Arrange the coated zucchini sticks in a single layer on a cooking rack or perforated tray. Spray generously with non-stick cooking spray.
Cook for 10-12 minutes. Halfway through the cooking time, gently turn the sticks and spray the other side with cooking spray to ensure even crisping.
tip: For a crispier texture, substitute standard breadcrumbs with Panko breadcrumbs.

title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wings (Extra-Crispy Crust)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
description: American pub-style wings at home! The cornstarch trick paired with air frying dries the skin, creating an irresistible garlic and Parmesan crust in 25 minutes.
instructions: Thoroughly pat the chicken wings dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine cornstarch, half of the Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the wings and toss until evenly coated.
Preheat the appliance to 383°F.
Arrange the wings in a single layer in the basket. Spray with cooking spray and cook for 25 minutes, turning them halfway through.
Remove the wings from the basket and immediately toss with the remaining Parmesan cheese.
tip: Use cornstarch to absorb moisture from the chicken skin, creating a crisp crust.

title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken Wings (Spicy and Crispy)
description: A trip to Jamaica in 25 minutes. Aromatic and pleasantly spicy wings. Air frying helps the Jerk spice mix cling to the skin while rendering excess fat.
instructions: Dry the chicken wings thoroughly with paper towels.
In a bowl, combine all dry spices with the olive oil to form a paste.
Add the chicken wings to the paste and mix thoroughly to ensure an even coating.
Preheat the air fryer to 383°F.
Arrange the wings in a single layer in the basket. Cook for 25 minutes, turning them halfway through the cooking time.
Remove the wings from the basket. Squeeze fresh lime juice over them before serving.
tip: For additional heat, add one half of a finely minced Habanero chili to the spice mixture. Handle with gloves.

title: Ketchup and Mustard Glazed Chicken Wings (18 Mins)
description: A sweet and tangy favorite cooked low and slow at 340°F. The ketchup and mustard glaze caramelizes gently on the skin, creating a finger-licking finish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together ketchup, mustard, soy sauce, olive oil, and paprika.
Add the chicken wings to the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours, up to 12 hours.
Drain wings from excess marinade, reserving the marinade. Arrange the wings in the cooking basket.
Cook at 340°F for 18-20 minutes, turning the wings halfway through the cooking time.
For additional glazing, brush the wings with the reserved marinade during the final 3 minutes of cooking.
tip: Cook at 340°F. Sauces with high sugar content, such as ketchup and sweet soy sauce, are prone to burning at higher temperatures.

title: Honey Sriracha Chicken Wings (Sweet, Spicy and Sticky)
description: The perfect balance between the sweetness of honey and the heat of sriracha. Air-fry the wings until crisp for 25 mins, then toss them in the sauce. A bold, sticky finish for spice lovers.
instructions: Pat the chicken wings dry. In a large bowl, toss the wings with cornstarch, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika until evenly coated.
Preheat the cooking appliance to 383°F. Arrange the wings in a single layer. Spray with cooking spray. Cook for 25-30 minutes, turning them over at the halfway point.
While the wings cook, combine honey, Sriracha sauce, and rice vinegar in a small saucepan. Heat over low heat for 2-3 minutes, stirring continuously.
Remove the cooked wings and place them in a large bowl.
Pour the warm sauce over the wings and toss until evenly coated.
tip: To prevent the honey from burning, apply the glaze after cooking the wings.

title: Tender Chicken Tikka Masala Drumsticks
ingredients: 2.7 oz thick coconut milk or Greek yogurt
description: All the flavor of Tandoori in 20 minutes. The coconut milk tenderizes the chicken drumsticks while the hot air seals the Indian spices into a colorful, incredibly fragrant crust.
instructions: Score each chicken drumstick with 2-3 diagonal cuts to allow for deeper marinade penetration.
In a mixing bowl, combine the thick coconut milk, tomato paste, Garam Masala, ground cumin, ground turmeric, grated ginger, minced garlic, and salt.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl, ensuring they are fully coated with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat the appliance to 355°F.
Remove the drumsticks from the marinade, allowing excess to adhere to the meat. Arrange them in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, turning the drumsticks halfway through, until cooked through, golden brown, and slightly charred.
tip: Serve immediately with steamed basmati rice and Naan bread.

title: Cajun Chicken Tenders (Extra Crunch Breading)
ingredients: 17.6 oz chicken breast, cut into strips
description: Perfectly breaded chicken strips! Using buttermilk paired with a Cajun mix creates super crispy tenders without deep frying. The protein snack ready in just 12 minutes.
instructions: Combine buttermilk and hot sauce. Submerge chicken strips in the mixture and refrigerate for at least one hour.

In a shallow dish, combine flour, Cajun seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt. Add one tablespoon of the buttermilk marinade to the flour mixture and mix with fingertips to create small clumps for a textured coating.
Remove chicken strips from the marinade, allowing excess to drip off. Dredge each strip in the seasoned flour, pressing firmly to ensure an even coating.
Preheat the cooking appliance to 383°F. Arrange the coated tenders in a single layer in the basket. Spray generously with cooking oil.
Cook for 12-14 minutes. Halfway through the cooking time, flip the tenders and spray any dry flour spots with additional cooking oil.
tip: Adding a small amount of the liquid marinade to the flour mixture before breading creates a rougher texture, resulting in a crispier crust.

title: Garlic Lemon Chicken Drumsticks (Extra-Crispy Skin)
ingredients: Juice and zest of 1 large organic lemon
2 teaspoons garlic powder or 2 minced garlic cloves
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: A fresh, high-protein dinner. The air fryer renders the fat from the skin, making it extra crispy in 20 mins, while the lemon keeps the flavor bright.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pat the chicken drumsticks dry with paper towels. Add them to the bowl and coat thoroughly. Let marinate, covered, at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat the appliance to 383°F / 195°C.
Arrange the drumsticks in the cooking basket in a single layer, ensuring no overlap.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, depending on size. Turn the drumsticks halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Ensure the chicken skin is thoroughly dry before cooking to achieve maximum crispiness.

title: Mustard Chicken Thighs (Quick Sweet & Sour Glaze)
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup or liquid honey
description: A true gourmet dinner-saver in 22 minutes. The pungent mix of mustard and sweet maple glazes the chicken skin spectacularly in the air fryer without burning it.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the mustard, maple syrup, onion powder, garlic powder, and sweet paprika to create the glaze.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper. Using a silicone brush, apply the glaze to all sides of the chicken thighs, reserving a small amount.
Preheat the appliance to 375°F (190°C).
Cook for 22-25 minutes. Approximately 5-7 minutes before the end of the cooking time, turn the chicken thighs and apply the remaining glaze.
Serve immediately once the glaze is sticky and golden-brown.
tip: To facilitate cleaning, line the cooking surface with parchment paper or aluminum foil to catch any dripping glaze, which may burn due to its sugar content.

title: Yogurt Marinated Chicken Thighs (Tender and Fragrant)
ingredients: 4 large Chicken Thighs or Drumsticks, skin optional
1 sprig Fresh Rosemary, needles finely chopped
Salt and Black Pepper, to taste
description: How to prepare chicken that literally melts in your mouth? The acidity of the yogurt breaks down the meat fibers in 30 mins, ensuring super soft thighs, scented with rosemary and a fabulous crust.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, olive oil, mustard, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, salt, and pepper to create the marinade.
Submerge the chicken pieces in the marinade, ensuring all surfaces are evenly coated.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for a minimum of 4 hours, or overnight for optimal results.
Preheat the cooking appliance to 385°F. Remove the chicken from the marinade and wipe off any excess.
Arrange the chicken in a single layer. Cook for 30-35 minutes, turning the pieces halfway through the cooking time until a crust forms and the chicken is cooked through.
tip: Note: The yogurt marinade prevents the skin from crisping. This recipe is particularly effective with boneless, skinless thighs for maximum tenderness.

title: Crispy Pork Katsu (Japanese Panko Cutlet)
ingredients: 2 boneless pork chops, 6 oz each, 0.4-inch thick
description: The famous Japanese Tonkatsu cutlet in a lighter version. Breaded with panko and cooked in the air fryer in just 14 minutes, it stays moist and tender inside.
instructions: Score the fat edges of the pork chops to prevent curling. If thicker than 0.4-0.6 inches, flatten with a meat mallet.
Prepare three separate shallow dishes: one with flour; one with beaten eggs; and one with Panko breadcrumbs combined with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Coat each pork chop first in flour, shaking off excess. Dip in the beaten egg, allowing excess to drip off. Press firmly into the Panko mixture to ensure a complete coating.
Spray both sides of the breaded cutlets with cooking oil spray. Place them in the preheated cooking basket at 365°F.
Cook for 14-16 minutes, turning the cutlets over at the halfway point. If dry spots are visible on the Panko, apply additional oil spray.
tip: Use Panko breadcrumbs for this recipe. Standard breadcrumbs are not a suitable substitute as Panko provides the characteristic large-flake, crispy texture.

title: Eggplant Cutlets (Vegetarian & Crispy in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 1.8 oz grated Parmesan or Pecorino cheese
description: No meat tonight? Eggplant slices breaded with cheese become fabulous golden cutlets! Ready in 10 minutes, perfect for a side dish or a vegetarian main course everyone will love.
instructions: Wash the eggplant, trim the ends, and slice into 0.4-inch thick rounds.
Arrange three shallow bowls. Place flour in the first, beaten eggs seasoned with salt and pepper in the second, and breadcrumbs mixed with grated cheese in the third.
Dredge each eggplant slice in flour, dip in the egg mixture, then coat completely with the breadcrumb and cheese mixture.
Arrange the slices in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spray the top of each slice with olive oil.
Bake at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, turning the slices over halfway through the cooking time, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: For a thicker crust, repeat the egg and breadcrumb coating process a second time before cooking.

title: Homemade Fish Sticks (Kid-Friendly in 8 Mins)
ingredients: 14 oz thick white fish fillet (e.g., cod, plaice, hake)
1 tsp fish spice mix (e.g., dried parsley, lemon zest)
description: The classic fast-food fish sticks, but healthy and homemade. The cod stays incredibly soft while the crust becomes irresistibly golden in just 8 minutes.
instructions: Ensure fish is boneless. Pat thoroughly dry with paper towels. Cut into rectangular sticks approximately 1 inch thick.
In a shallow dish, combine flour, spice mix, salt, and pepper. In a second dish, beat the eggs. In a third dish, place the breadcrumbs.
Dredge each fish stick in the flour mixture, shaking off excess. Dip in the beaten egg, then coat completely with breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere.
Arrange the sticks in a single layer in the cooking basket. Spray the breading evenly with cooking spray.
Cook at 350°F for 8-10 minutes. Halfway through cooking, gently turn the sticks with a spatula to ensure even browning.
tip: The fish sticks are delicate. To prevent breakage, use a silicone spatula instead of tongs when turning them.

title: Cereal-Crusted Chicken Bites (Maximum Crunch)
description: Nuggets 2.0! Use corn flakes to create an extra-crunchy crust in the air fryer. The sealed chicken cubes cook in 15 minutes, ideal for dipping into sauces.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the mustard and hot sauce or paprika.
In a second bowl, combine the flour with salt, garlic powder, and onion powder. On a large plate, coarsely crush the corn flakes.
Dredge the chicken cubes in the seasoned flour, dip in the egg mixture, then coat with the crushed corn flakes, pressing to adhere.
Place the coated chicken bites in the cooking basket in a single layer. Spray with cooking oil.
Cook at 355°F for 15-18 minutes, flipping halfway through.
tip: For a consistent crumb and minimal cleanup, place corn flakes in a sealed bag and crush them with a rolling pin.

title: Sausage-Stuffed Mushrooms (Gratin in 12 Mins)
ingredients: 1.8 oz shredded mild provolone or mozzarella
description: The gourmet appetizer to empty the fridge! Soft mushroom caps with an explosive filling of meat and melted cheese, perfectly gratinated at 320°F without burning.
instructions: Clean mushrooms with a damp paper towel. Remove and finely chop the stems. Set the caps aside.
In a skillet, sauté the chopped stems, crumbled sausage, and whole garlic clove in olive oil for 5 minutes. Remove and discard the garlic clove.
Allow the filling to cool slightly. Transfer to a bowl and combine with breadcrumbs, parsley, Parmesan, and most of the provolone.
Fill each mushroom cap with the sausage mixture, forming a slight mound. Top with the remaining provolone.
Cook at 320°F for 12-14 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and the topping is golden and melted.
tip: Cook at 320°F to ensure the mushrooms become tender without drying out and to prevent the cheese from burning. Higher temperatures may result in undercooked mushrooms and burnt topping.

title: Chicken & Vegetable Spring Rolls (Crispy, No Deep Fry)
ingredients: 5.3 oz chicken breast, diced or ground
5.3 oz mixed vegetables (carrot, cabbage, leek), julienned
1.8 oz rice vermicelli, softened and chopped
Vegetable oil, for cooking and brushing
description: Like a Chinese restaurant but without the heavy frying! Rice paper rolls puffed and crisped by hot air in 15 minutes, enclosing a tender heart of vegetables and chicken.
instructions: Heat one tablespoon of oil in a wok or skillet over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken until opaque, add the julienned vegetables and soy sauce, and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat, incorporate the vermicelli, and allow the filling to cool completely.
Briefly immerse one rice paper sheet in warm water to soften. Place it flat on a clean kitchen towel.
Place approximately two tablespoons of filling in the center. Fold the right and left sides inward over the filling, then roll tightly from the bottom up to form a cylinder.
Brush the spring rolls thoroughly with oil. Arrange them in a single layer in the cooking basket, ensuring they do not touch.
Cook at 355°F for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: When using rice paper, generously oil both the cooking basket and the spring rolls to prevent sticking and tearing.

title: Pigs in a Blanket (Quick & Crispy in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 12 cocktail sausages, or 4 large sausages, cut into thirds
1 egg, beaten, or 2 tablespoons milk, for brushing
description: The world's most loved appetizer! Wrap mini sausages in puff pastry and air-fry them: they will puff up perfectly in 10 minutes, beating the slowness of the traditional oven.
instructions: Cut the puff pastry into 1-inch wide strips.
Wrap each sausage with a puff pastry strip.
Pinch the dough edges firmly to seal.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg or milk. Sprinkle with sesame or poppy seeds, if desired.
Arrange items in the basket, ensuring they are spaced apart. Cook at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, or until the pastry is puffed and golden-brown.
tip: Maintain at least 1 inch of space between each item. The puff pastry expands during cooking and items placed too close may stick together.

title: Juicy Chicken Breasts (Tender & Moist in 18 Mins)
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (approx. 7 oz / 200g each)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: Afraid your chicken breast will turn rubbery in the air fryer? Follow this 375°F method to seal the juices inside: you'll get perfect lean protein in 18 minutes for your meal prep.
instructions: Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika or mixed herbs.
Preheat the appliance to 375°F (190°C).
Arrange the chicken breasts in a single layer and cook for 18-20 minutes, depending on thickness.
Flip the chicken breasts halfway through the cooking time to ensure even cooking.
tip: Verify doneness by cutting into the thickest part. The interior should be opaque and white. For precise results, use a meat thermometer to ensure an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

title: BBQ Chicken (Sticky & Caramelized in 22 Mins)
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: All the grill flavor without the smoke! Air-fry the spiced chicken to seal in juices, brushing with BBQ sauce at the very end for a true pitmaster caramelized glaze.
instructions: Combine brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to create the dry rub.
Pat the chicken pieces dry with a paper towel. Coat the chicken evenly with the dry rub. Let the chicken rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat the appliance to 383°F. Place the chicken in the basket and cook for 22-25 minutes.
After approximately 15 minutes of cooking, brush the chicken pieces with a generous layer of barbecue sauce.
Continue cooking for 4 minutes. Turn the chicken pieces and brush the other side with barbecue sauce. Cook for the remaining time until a sticky crust forms and the chicken is cooked through.
tip: Apply the barbecue sauce towards the end of the cooking time. Applying the sauce at the beginning of the cooking process will cause the sugars to burn and develop a bitter taste.

title: Honey Lemon Chicken Legs (Crispy & Sticky)
description: Finger-licking sweet and sour chicken legs in 20 minutes. The honey-lemon combo creates a sticky, golden crust, while the meat falls right off the bone.
instructions: Combine honey, soy sauce, lemon juice, and garlic in a large mixing bowl to create the marinade.
Add chicken drumsticks to the marinade, ensuring they are fully coated. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Remove drumsticks from the marinade, allowing excess to drip off. Reserve the remaining marinade. Arrange the drumsticks in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 375°F for 20-22 minutes. If necessary, drain excess liquid from the basket during cooking.
In the final 5 minutes of cooking, brush the reserved marinade over the chicken to create a glaze.
tip: Monitor the chicken closely during the final 5 minutes as the honey glaze can burn quickly. If excessive browning occurs, reduce the temperature to 320°F.

title: Five-Spice Asian Chicken Thighs (Perfect Glaze)
description: A trip to Asia without leaving home! Perfectly glazed chicken thighs in 18 minutes thanks to the Hoisin marinade. Hyper-crispy skin and moisture locked in by convection cooking.
instructions: In a bowl, combine Hoisin sauce, oyster sauce, grated garlic, grated ginger, five-spice powder, 1 tablespoon of honey, and 1 tablespoon of dark soy sauce to create the marinade.
Thoroughly coat the chicken thighs with the marinade, applying some under the skin. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat the appliance to 375°F (190°C). Remove chicken from the marinade and pat dry, wiping off excess.
Arrange chicken thighs skin-side down in a single layer. Cook for 10 minutes.
Flip the thighs. Continue to cook skin-side up for 8-10 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
In a small bowl, combine the remaining 1 tablespoon of honey and 1 tablespoon of dark soy sauce. Brush this glaze over the chicken skin during the final 2-3 minutes of cooking.
tip: Chinese five-spice powder has a potent flavor. Use it in moderation.

title: Garlic & Herb Roasted Chicken (Super Crispy Skin)
ingredients: 8 assorted chicken pieces (drumsticks and thighs recommended)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: How do you degrease chicken pieces while keeping the skin as crispy as a potato chip? This 385°F recipe for 22 mins evaporates all the fat into the basket below.
instructions: Pat the chicken pieces thoroughly dry with paper towels.
Coat the chicken pieces evenly with olive oil.
In a small bowl, combine garlic powder, herbs, salt, and pepper. Rub the seasoning mixture evenly over all sides of the chicken pieces.
Let the chicken rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Arrange the chicken pieces in a single layer, ensuring no overlap.
Set the appliance to 385°F (195°C) and cook for 22-25 minutes, flipping the pieces halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Use garlic powder instead of fresh minced garlic to prevent burning and bitterness at high temperatures.

title: Whole Roasted Chicken (Crispy Outside, Tender Inside in 50 Mins)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cleaned and gutted (approx. 42-49 oz)
3 tbsp olive oil or melted butter
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: Afraid to air-fry a whole chicken (max 2.6 lbs)? By flipping it halfway (30 mins breast down, 20 mins breast up), you'll get a super moist breast and rotisserie-crisp thighs.
instructions: Ensure the chicken fits within the cooking appliance, leaving adequate space from the heat source to prevent burning.
Pat the chicken dry, both inside and out. Insert the whole garlic cloves and rosemary sprig into the cavity. Secure the legs with kitchen twine.
Rub the exterior skin with olive oil or melted butter. Season with salt, black pepper, sweet paprika, and garlic powder.
Place the chicken breast-side down. Cook at 355°F for 30 minutes.
Carefully turn the chicken breast-side up. Increase temperature to 375°F and continue cooking for 20-25 minutes, or until the skin is crisp and the chicken is cooked through.
tip: If the skin browns excessively before the chicken is fully cooked, cover the breast area with a small piece of aluminum foil for the remainder of the cooking time.

title: Whole BBQ Chicken (American Gourmet Glaze in 50 Mins)
description: The leveled-up roast chicken! Cook it whole at 355°F to seal the meat, then in the last 10 mins lower to 320°F and brush generously with BBQ sauce for a sweet-and-sour, smoke-free crust.
instructions: Truss the chicken legs. Pat the skin dry. Rub the entire surface with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the chicken in the basket, breast-side down. Cook at 355°F for 30 minutes.
Flip the chicken breast-side up. Continue cooking for 10 minutes.
For the final 10 minutes, reduce the temperature to 320°F. Brush the exposed surface of the chicken with BBQ sauce.
Cook for 5 minutes. Apply a second coat of BBQ sauce. Cook for the final 5 minutes, or until the glaze is set.
tip: Reduce the temperature to 320°F before applying the BBQ sauce. This prevents the sugar in the sauce from burning and producing smoke.

title: Parmesan Meatballs (Oil-Free & Super Soft in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 14 oz ground meat (beef, or a beef and pork blend)
description: Grandma's classic meatballs in a lighter version! Golden and flavorful outside, they stay incredibly soft inside by air-frying for 10 minutes, without the heaviness of pan-frying.
instructions: Soak the stale bread in milk for several minutes. Squeeze to remove excess liquid and place in a large mixing bowl.
Add the ground meat, egg, grated Parmesan, chopped parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix by hand until the ingredients are just combined. Avoid overmixing to prevent toughness.
Form the mixture into uniform meatballs, approximately 1.5 inches in diameter.
Arrange the meatballs in a single layer in the cooking basket, ensuring space between each for proper air circulation. Lightly spray the tops with cooking oil.
Cook at 385°F for 10-12 minutes. Turn the meatballs halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: For a crispier exterior, roll the raw meatballs in breadcrumbs and spray with cooking oil before cooking.

title: Chicken & Pepper Quesadillas (Crispy & Melty in 15 Mins)
ingredients: 5 oz Shredded Cheese Blend (Edam, Cheddar, Provolone)
description: An explosive, time-saving Tex-Mex dinner! Super crispy tortillas stuffed with chicken, spiced peppers, and a melty cheese heart. The air fryer seals the filling in minutes without getting greasy.
instructions: Combine chicken, bell pepper, onion, oil, and seasoning in a bowl. Transfer the mixture to the cooking basket. Cook at 375°F for 10 minutes, shaking at the halfway point.
Remove the cooked filling from the basket. Wipe the basket clean.
Place the filling on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold to create a half-moon shape.
Arrange the quesadillas in the basket. Secure the top flap of each tortilla with a toothpick to prevent it from opening during cooking.
Cook at 375°F for 4-5 minutes, or until the tortilla is toasted and the cheese is fully melted.
tip: Securing the tortilla with a toothpick is a necessary step. The high-velocity fan can lift the top layer, causing the filling to spill.

title: Greek Lamb & Potatoes (Authentic Flavor in 45 Mins)
ingredients: 35 oz boneless lamb shoulder or leg, cut into large pieces
18 oz baby potatoes, washed and halved
4 oz vegetable broth or warm water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
description: The classic Sunday lunch without turning on the oven! The lamb meat cooks over the baby potatoes, releasing its savory juices for a super tender and golden one-pan meal in 45 minutes.
instructions: Combine olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Rub the marinade onto the lamb and let it rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Arrange the potatoes in the cooking basket. Season with salt and pepper. Add the vegetable broth or water.
Place a rack over the potatoes and arrange the marinated lamb on the rack. Alternatively, place the lamb directly on the potatoes.
Cook at 355°F for 45-50 minutes.
After 25 minutes, remove the lamb. Toss the potatoes. Turn the lamb over and return it to cook for the remaining time.
tip: Ensure the lamb is deboned and butterflied. Thick cuts may cook unevenly.

title: Yogurt Chicken Skewers (Incredibly Tender in 12 Mins)
ingredients: 14 oz chicken breast or thighs, cubed (1.2-inch)
3.5 oz plain whole milk Greek yogurt
description: No more dry skewers! Greek yogurt breaks down the chicken fibers making it incredibly soft, while the hot air seals the outside creating a killer Middle Eastern Shish Taouk in 12 mins.
instructions: Combine yogurt, olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add chicken cubes and mix until fully coated. Refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours, up to 4 hours for optimal results.
Soak wooden skewers in cold water for at least 10 minutes to prevent burning.
Thread the marinated chicken cubes onto the skewers, removing any excess marinade. Arrange skewers in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook at 385°F for 12-14 minutes. Turn the skewers halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Ensure skewers are sized to fit within the cooking appliance.

title: Stuffed Stromboli (Crispy & Melty Pizza Roll in 20 Mins)
ingredients: Salt, dried oregano, and garlic powder, to taste
description: A golden stuffed roll with a crisp crust and a melty savory center. Perfect for slicing and serving hot in a faster air-fryer version.
instructions: Allow the dough to reach room temperature. Roll it out on a lightly floured surface.
Arrange the ham, cheese slices, and chopped peppers evenly over one half of the dough.
Roll the dough tightly into a log. Pinch the seams and edges to seal completely, preventing leakage of the filling.
Combine the beaten egg and milk to create an egg wash. Brush the surface of the roll with the egg wash. Sprinkle with salt, oregano, and garlic powder.
Preheat the appliance to 350°F. Place the roll inside and cook for 20 minutes. Turn the roll halfway through the cooking time for even browning.
tip: For a golden-brown crust, brush the surface with an egg wash. Make several small slits on top of the roll to allow steam to vent during cooking. Ensure the roll is turned halfway through the cooking process for uniform results.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin (Golden Crust & Pink Heart in 25 Mins)
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: No more dry roasts! Air-fried pork tenderloin at high temperature forms a perfect crust in just 25 minutes, keeping a pink, succulent, and highly protein-rich heart.
instructions: Dry the pork tenderloins thoroughly with paper towels.
Brush the tenderloins evenly with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the seasoned tenderloins in the preheated cooking appliance.
Cook at 375°F for 25-30 minutes, adjusting for the specific size of the tenderloins.
Turn the tenderloins halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
tip: Use a meat thermometer to verify internal temperature without cutting the meat.

title: Balsamic Beef Steak (Gourmet Cooking in 7 Mins)
description: A restaurant-quality gourmet steak. The mustard and balsamic vinegar marinade caramelizes at 400°F creating a very flavorful crust, while the inside of the meat stays rare. Ready in 7 mins.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and Dijon mustard until emulsified.
Submerge the steak in the marinade, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for approximately two hours.
Remove the steak from the refrigerator and allow it to reach room temperature before cooking.
Preheat the cooking appliance to 400°F. Place the steak inside and cook for 7 minutes.
After cooking, slice the steak against the grain. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with sliced fresh basil.
tip: Flip the steak halfway through the cooking time for even cooking. Slice the meat against the grain to ensure maximum tenderness.

title: Herb Beef Ribeye (Charcoal Flavor in 7 Mins)
ingredients: Dried oregano, rosemary, and sage to taste
description: Get the classic Californian charcoal flavor right at home without smoking up the kitchen. The dried herb 'Rub' forms a delicious crust on this super protein ribeye in just 7 minutes.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, rosemary, sage, and cayenne pepper.
Brush the steak on all sides with olive oil.
Coat the steak evenly with the spice mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F.
Place the steak in the basket and cook for 7 minutes, or until the desired doneness is reached.
Remove the steak and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
tip: For even browning, flip the steak halfway through the cooking time.

title: New York Strip with Chimichurri (Quick Recipe in 7 Mins)
ingredients: 2 New York strip steaks (approx. 32 oz total)
4.4 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
description: A New York strip steak quickly seared at high temperature for a wow crust! To be served sliced and covered with a fresh herb chimichurri sauce. An amazing main course ready in 7 mins.
instructions: Prepare the sauce: Combine basil, cilantro, parsley, anchovy fillets, shallots, and garlic in a food processor. Pulse until finely chopped. With the motor running, slowly stream in the olive oil and lemon juice until emulsified. Set aside.
Prepare the steaks: Pat the steaks dry. Coat lightly with neutral oil and season generously with salt and black pepper.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F.
Place the steaks in the basket in a single layer, ensuring they do not overlap.
Cook for 7-9 minutes for medium-rare. Flip the steaks halfway through the cooking time. Adjust the duration based on steak thickness and desired doneness.
Transfer the steaks to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing against the grain.
Serve the sliced steak with the prepared herb sauce.
tip: For a more even cooking result, allow the steaks to come to room temperature for approximately 20-30 minutes before seasoning and cooking.

title: Bone-in Pork Chops (Juicy & Golden in 14 Mins)
ingredients: 2 bone-in pork chops, approx. 9 oz (250g) each
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
description: No more pork chops as dry as shoe soles! The air fryer cooks them at 375°F sealing the surface in 14 minutes: the fat melts, the bone adds flavor, and the meat stays super moist.
instructions: Preheat the appliance to 375°F (190°C).
Thoroughly pat the pork chops dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Brush both sides of the chops with olive oil.
Season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Arrange the chops in the basket in a single layer, ensuring no overlap.
Cook for 14-17 minutes, flipping the chops halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Brushing the meat with oil promotes the Maillard reaction for enhanced browning. Turning the food halfway through the cooking process ensures it cooks evenly.

title: BBQ Pork Chops (Caramelized US Style in 11 Mins)
description: The flavor of an American barbecue right in your home. The Rub (spice mix and brown sugar) brutally caramelizes at 400°F creating a very flavorful crust in just 11 minutes.
instructions: In a bowl, combine brown sugar, paprika, mustard powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Mix thoroughly.
Coat the boneless pork chops evenly with vegetable oil.
Dredge the pork chops in the spice mixture, pressing firmly to ensure an even coating.
Place the pork chops in a cooking basket preheated to 400°F.
Cook for 11 minutes. Remove the pork chops and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
tip: Ensure the spice mixture is evenly distributed on the meat to form a uniform crust. Turn the pork chops halfway through the cooking time for even cooking.

title: Mini Cheeseburgers (Juicy Sliders in 9 Mins)
description: Perfect mini burgers for appetizers! No smoking pans: the beef patties air-fry nicely and juicy in 9 minutes, and the cheese melts flawlessly right in the basket.
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground beef, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, grated onion, and beaten egg. Season with salt and pepper. Mix until just combined.
Form the mixture into equal-sized patties. Refrigerate for approximately one hour to firm.
Preheat the appliance to 400°F.
Brush the patties with olive oil and arrange them in a single layer in the cooking basket.
Cook for 9 minutes, flipping the patties halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning.
During the final minute of cooking, place one slice of cheese on each patty and allow it to melt.
Remove the patties, assemble the sliders with the buns, and serve immediately.
tip: For optimal results, do not overcrowd the cooking basket. Cook in batches if necessary. The cheese should be added only during the final 60 seconds of cooking to prevent over-melting.

title: Lemon Lamb Chops (Pink Center & Crispy Crust)
ingredients: Salt and ground black pepper, to taste
description: A Michelin-star sear in just 10 minutes! Lemon-marinated lamb chops become crispy on the outside while keeping a tender, perfectly pink heart when sliced.
instructions: Zest the lemon, avoiding the white pith. Crush the garlic cloves.
Combine the crushed garlic, olive oil, and lemon zest to create the marinade.
Coat the lamb chops thoroughly with the marinade. Refrigerate for approximately four hours.
Arrange the chops in a single layer in the preheated appliance at 400°F.
Cook for 10 minutes, turning the chops halfway through the cooking time.
tip: Marinate the meat for at least 4 hours to enhance tenderness and flavor. Turn the chops halfway through cooking to ensure even browning.

title: Beef Empanadas (Flaky Turnovers Without Deep Frying)
description: Bring Argentina to your table! Shortcrust pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef, puffed and flaky in 20 minutes. The smoke-free alternative for light empanadas that aren't dripping with oil.
instructions: Finely chop scallions. Sauté in a pan with olive oil for 3 minutes.
Add ground beef and paprika. Cook for 10 minutes. Let the filling cool completely.
Unroll pastry and cut into circles. Place a portion of the cooled filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the pastry circles into a half-moon shape. Press and seal the edges firmly.
Prepare an egg wash with the yolk and a small amount of water. Brush the pastries. Cook in two batches at 400°F for 10 minutes per batch.
tip: Ensure the filling is completely cool before assembling to prevent the pastry from becoming soggy.

title: Pork Tenderloin & Vegetables (One-Pan Meal in 35 Mins)
description: The magical air fryer "One-Pot". The juices of the honey-marinated pork tenderloin drip onto the vegetables below, flavoring peppers and zucchini while the meat sears perfectly in 35 mins.
instructions: Prepare the marinade: in a jar, combine a portion of the olive oil, vinegar, honey, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Whisk vigorously.
Coat the pork tenderloins with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of two hours.
In a bowl, combine all diced vegetables. Toss with the remaining olive oil and fresh basil.
Arrange the vegetables in an even layer in the cooking basket. Place the marinated pork tenderloins directly on top.
Cook at 375°F for 35 minutes. After 20 minutes, temporarily remove the pork, stir the vegetables, then return the pork to the basket to complete cooking.
tip: For optimal flavor, marinate the pork for a minimum of 2 hours. Stir the vegetables partway through the cooking process to ensure even cooking.

title: Lamb Chops (Super Tender in 10 Minutes)
description: A delicacy ready in just 10 minutes. The heat at 400°F melts the fat and creates a rosemary-scented crust around the bone, while the lamb meat stays incredibly juicy and pink.
instructions: Pat the lamb chops completely dry with paper towels.
Rub the meat with oil spray, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Preheat to 390°F (200°C) for 3 minutes.
Place the chops in the basket in a single layer. Cook for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove and let the meat rest for 2 minutes before serving.
tip: Want a crunchier crust? Sprinkle a pinch of parmesan cheese on the chops during the last 2 minutes of cooking!

title: Mini Easter Pies (Savory Tartlets Ready in 15 Mins)
