Transfer cooked potatoes to a serving bowl. Immediately garnish with crumbled feta, fresh parsley, and oregano.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.
tip: Garnish with feta and herbs after cooking. Applying them during the cooking process will cause the cheese to melt excessively and separate.

title: Curly Fries (Extra Crispy Spirals in 18 Mins)
description: The most loved fries by kids, ready with zero effort! The spiral cut perfectly catches the hot air vortex, creating hyper-crispy curls in just 18 minutes straight from the freezer, no extra oil needed.
instructions: Place the frozen curly fries directly into the cooking basket.
Do not add oil. The product is pre-fried and will release sufficient oil during cooking to achieve a golden-brown color.
Cook at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through the cooking time to ensure even browning. If necessary, shake again 5 minutes before the end of the cooking cycle.
tip: Do not overfill the basket. Ensure there is enough space for hot air to circulate for even cooking.

title: Veggie & Feta Samosas (Crispy Pockets in 15 Mins)
ingredients: 5.3 oz sweet peas, fresh or frozen
description: Discover the art of brick pastry in a light version. These classic oriental turnovers stuffed with feta and cauliflower puff up in the air fryer, becoming super flaky in 15 minutes. Ideal for stylishly emptying the fridge.
instructions: Steam or pan-cook the cauliflower florets and peas until tender.
In a bowl, mash the cooked vegetables with crumbled feta cheese. Season with salt and pepper to create a coarse mixture.
Halve the pastry sheets. Place a spoonful of the vegetable mixture on one end of each half and fold into a triangle, enclosing the filling.
Seal the final edge of the pastry with the beaten egg yolk. Brush the surface of each triangle with olive oil.
Arrange the samosas in the cooking basket. Cook at 340°F for 15 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden brown and crisp.
tip: Ensure the vegetable filling is not excessively moist to prevent the pastry from becoming soggy or tearing. Pat dry if necessary.

title: Banana Mascarpone Cake (Soft & Moist in 35 Mins)
description: A dense, moist, and super easy cake! The air fryer bakes this walnut and banana-rich batter in 35 minutes, yielding a soft texture and perfect browning ready to be topped with mascarpone cream.
instructions: Peel and mash the bananas with a fork to a coarse pulp.
Whisk in the dark brown sugar and sunflower oil until well combined.
Sift and gradually incorporate the self-rising flour using a spatula. Fold in the chopped walnuts.
Pour the batter into a suitable cake pan.
Bake at 320°F for approximately 35 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Frost the top with mascarpone.
tip: Verify doneness by inserting a toothpick into the center of the cake. If it emerges clean, the cake is fully baked.

title: Frozen Breaded Mushrooms (Golden Appetizer in 15 Mins)
ingredients: 10.6 oz frozen, pre-breaded whole or quartered mushrooms
description: Take the breaded mushrooms out of the freezer, toss them in the basket, and in 15 minutes you'll have a piping hot, crispy finger food. The hot air melts the frost without making the breading soggy.
instructions: Place the frozen breaded mushrooms directly into the cooking basket.
Arrange the mushrooms in a single layer.
Do not add oil; the pre-breaded coating contains sufficient fat for cooking.
Cook at 375°F for 15 to 18 minutes, until the coating is golden brown and crisp.
Halfway through the cooking time, shake the basket vigorously to ensure even browning.
tip: Do not thaw the mushrooms before cooking to prevent moisture from compromising the breading. Shaking the basket halfway through the cooking process is essential for a uniform result.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich (The Melty Classic in 8 Mins)
description: No hassle of flipping the toast in a pan! Brush butter on the outside of the bread and the air fryer will toast it evenly on both sides, melting the cheddar inside. The American snack in 8 mins.
instructions: Preheat the appliance to 320°F.
Brush one side of each bread slice with melted butter.
Place the cheese slices on the unbuttered side of two bread slices. Top with the remaining bread slices, buttered-side up.
Place the assembled sandwiches in the basket and cook for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove when golden brown. Cut diagonally and serve immediately.
tip: Apply butter only to the outer sides of the bread to achieve a golden crust.

title: Cajun Shrimp (Spicy & Juicy in 5 Minutes)
description: Protein-packed, spicy, and lightning fast! These shrimp cook in a record time of 5 minutes. The Cajun spices create a flavorful crust, while the inside of the shrimp doesn't dry out in the slightest.
instructions: Rinse shrimp and pat dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, combine shrimp, olive oil, fine sea salt, and Cajun seasoning. Toss to coat evenly.
Preheat the appliance to 375°F.
Arrange the seasoned shrimp in a single layer in the basket.
Cook for 5 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through the cooking time.
Remove from the appliance and serve immediately.
tip: To prevent a tough texture, do not overcook the shrimp. Serve with fresh citrus wedges to complement the spice.

title: Buttered Corn on the Cob (Sweet & Salty Roast in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 1 large fresh ear of yellow sweet corn
0.5 oz of softened or melted butter
description: Have you ever seen a corn cob roast so quickly? Cut it in half, slather it with butter, and in just 10 minutes at 400°F the kernels become plump, sweet, and perfectly charred.
instructions: Remove husks and silk from the corn. Cut the ear in half.
Brush corn kernels thoroughly with melted butter and season with salt.
Place corn in the cooking appliance basket. Initiate cooking at 400°F.
Cook for 10 minutes, rotating halfway through to ensure uniform browning.
tip: Rotate the corn midway through the cooking cycle to ensure uniform toasting and optimal aroma development.

title: Mini Pepperoni Pizza (Pizzeria Crunch in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 2 round pre-made pizza dough crusts (approx. 7 inches)
Light coating of high-quality oil for brushing the base
6 oz mozzarella, shredded or torn into small pieces
1.8 oz finely grated Grana Padano cheese
description: No more soggy edges! The trick for a spectacular American mini pizza is air-prebaking the crust for 5 mins. Then add sauce, cheese, and pepperoni, bake for another 5 mins, and you'll have a cracker-like base.
instructions: Apply a thin layer of oil to the flattened dough rounds. Preheat the air fryer to 320°F (160°C).
Position the unadorned dough within the air fryer basket. Toast for 5 minutes.
Carefully extract the pre-baked crust. Distribute tomato sauce evenly, then layer with shredded mozzarella and grated cheese.
Arrange pepperoni slices uniformly over the cheese layer.
Return to the air fryer. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and exhibits bubbling.
tip: Pre-baking the dough prior to topping application is recommended to mitigate base saturation.

title: Garlic Bread (Golden Parmesan & Garlic Bread in 8 Mins)
description: Have a piece of stale baguette? Slice it, stuff it with butter, garlic, and parmesan, and cook at 320°F. In 8 minutes the fat melts into the bread, toasting it. The ultimate dipping side.
instructions: Slice the baguette lengthwise, then crosswise into uniform, thick pieces to maximize surface area for absorption.
In a small bowl, combine butter, olive oil, grated Parmesan, and minced garlic until homogenous.
Distribute the garlic butter mixture thoroughly and uniformly over the surface of each bread slice.
Place the prepared bread into the cooking appliance basket and cook at 320°F for 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley prior to serving.
tip: Apply the garlic butter mixture thoroughly prior to cooking; heat facilitates absorption into the bread's structure, contributing to optimal crispness.

title: Golden Air-Fried Corn on the Cob
ingredients: 1 tbsp (0.5 oz) extra virgin olive oil
description: Achieve that fire-roasted flavor without the grill. Rapid air circulation caramelizes the natural sugars in the corn, creating a sweet and smoky vegetable side.
instructions: Remove husks and silks from corn. Wash and pat dry.
Apply olive oil evenly to cobs. Season generously with coarse sea salt.
Arrange cobs in a single layer within the air fryer basket to ensure optimal air circulation and uniform browning.
Cook at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, rotating cobs midway through cooking to achieve consistent charring.
tip: Ensure complete removal of husks and silks prior to oil application. Frequent rotation during cooking promotes uniform browning and charring.

title: Mexican Mini Pizzas (Beans, Corn & Cheese in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 2 pre-made soft puff pastry discs (approx. 6.7 inches diameter)
Extra virgin olive oil for brushing
4.2 oz of zesty Mexican-style sauce (sweet and spicy)
6 oz of shredded Mexican cheese blend (e.g., Cheddar, Monterey Jack)
1.4 oz sweet corn kernels (thawed) and 2.1 oz black beans, mixed with a small handful (0.5 oz) of peas
description: Bring a Tex-Mex touch to the table with these crispy mini pizzas! The combination of black beans, corn, and melted cheese creates a hearty and original snack that cooks to perfection in just 10 minutes.
instructions: Preheat the cooking appliance to 320°F.
Lightly brush pastry discs with olive oil. Place discs into the cooking appliance basket.
Bake pastry bases for 5 minutes, or until lightly golden. Carefully remove.
Distribute Mexican sauce over the bases. Top with shredded cheese, black beans, corn, and peas.
Return to the cooking appliance. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbling.
tip: To prevent the pastry base from becoming soggy, apply wet toppings and cheese exclusively during the final 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Chickpea & Spinach Veggie Burger (Light & Golden in 14 Mins)
ingredients: 5 oz (142g) fresh spinach, sautéed and moisture-extracted
1 whole egg (or 2 tablespoons starch for vegan preparation)
0.07 oz (2g) cumin and 0.07 oz (2g) sweet paprika
Salt, pepper, and non-stick cooking spray
description: No more rubbery veggie burgers! This homemade version with chickpeas and spinach stays tender inside but develops a delicious crust thanks to convection cooking. A healthy, protein-packed, light main.
instructions: Combine chickpeas, thoroughly squeezed spinach, spices, salt, pepper, and egg in a blender or food processor.
Process until a moldable, rustic-textured mixture is achieved; avoid over-processing.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, incorporate breadcrumbs, and knead. Form into four large patties using dampened hands.
Lightly coat the cooking appliance basket with non-stick spray. Arrange patties within the basket and lightly spray their surfaces.
Cook at 355°F (179°C) for 14 minutes, carefully turning patties midway through the cooking cycle.
tip: Thoroughly extract moisture from the spinach prior to blending. Residual water content will compromise mixture consistency, hindering patty formation.

title: Ricotta Stuffed Zucchini Boats (Perfect Gratin in 16 Mins)
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil
description: Looking for a refined yet simple vegetarian main? These zucchini boats with ricotta and mint cream are fresh and light, with a perfect gratin achieved in just 16 minutes of air frying.
instructions: Clean zucchini, bisect longitudinally, and excavate central pulp using a spoon or melon baller to form cavities.
Mince extracted pulp and combine in a vessel with ricotta, Parmesan, egg, mint, sodium chloride, and piper nigrum.
Apply a thin layer of olive oil to the interior of the zucchini cavities. Subsequently, fill generously with the ricotta mixture.
Arrange prepared zucchini in a single layer within the cooking apparatus. Process at 350°F for approximately 16 minutes.
Extract from the cooking apparatus upon achieving fork-tender zucchini consistency and optimal browning of the filling.
tip: Pre-drain ricotta in a fine-mesh sieve for a minimum of one hour prior to incorporation. Failure to do so will result in excessive whey release, compromising the textural integrity of the filling.

title: Capers Gratinated Peppers (Flavorful in 14 Minutes)
ingredients: 2 large fleshy bell peppers (red or yellow)
description: Sweet and meaty pepper strips made irresistible by a fragrant garlic and caper breading. A quick, flavorful side dish that unleashes the aromas of Mediterranean cuisine in under 15 minutes.
instructions: Wash bell peppers, remove stem, seeds, and internal membranes. Cut into wide strips.
Combine breadcrumbs, capers, minced garlic, parsley, salt, pepper, and half of the olive oil in a small bowl to form the breadcrumb mixture.
Arrange pepper strips in the cooking basket, concave side facing upward.
Fill each strip with the prepared breadcrumb mixture. Drizzle remaining olive oil over the filled strips.
Cook at 365°F for 14 minutes, or until peppers are softened and breadcrumbs are golden brown.
tip: For an intensified savory profile, incorporate two finely chopped anchovy fillets into the breadcrumb mixture. Adjust salt content as necessary.

title: Parmesan Asparagus (Irresistible Crunch in 8 Minutes)
description: Elevate your asparagus with this gourmet version! The mix of Parmesan and flaked almonds creates a crunchy shell that contrasts beautifully with the tenderness of the quick air-fried asparagus.
instructions: Wash asparagus and remove woody ends by snapping them manually at their natural breaking point.
Place asparagus in a tray or dish, drizzle with olive oil, and toss to ensure even coating.
Arrange asparagus in a single layer within the cooking basket and season with salt and pepper.
Generously sprinkle Parmesan and almond flakes, concentrating application on the tips.
Cook at 375°F (190°C) for approximately 8 minutes, or until the cheese develops an amber crust.
tip: Avoid overcooking to preserve optimal color and textural integrity.

title: Lemon Roasted Fennel Wedges (Delicate & Light in 15 Mins)
ingredients: Coarse salt and black pepper to taste
description: If you think fennel is boring, you must try it roasted! The hot air makes it tender and caramelized, while the lemon and fennel seeds enhance its natural freshness. Perfect, low-calorie side dish.
instructions: Prepare fennel by removing tough upper stalks and fibrous outer layers.
Halve each bulb, then cut into 6-8 uniform wedges, ensuring the core remains intact to maintain structural integrity.
In a bowl, combine fennel wedges with olive oil, salt, pepper, and optional fennel seeds.
Arrange wedges in a single layer within the cooking basket. Cook at 355°F for 15 minutes, turning halfway through the cooking cycle.
Serve promptly, garnished with fresh lemon juice.
tip: Retain a segment of the base core within each wedge to ensure structural cohesion during the cooking process.

title: Caramelized Red Onions (The Perfect Sweet & Sour in 16 Mins)
ingredients: A pinch of salt and pepper
description: Transform simple red onions into a gourmet side dish or the perfect hamburger topping. The air fryer caramelizes the sugars and balsamic vinegar, creating a thick and irresistible glaze.
instructions: Peel and cut red onions into thick wedges or large rings.
Combine onion pieces with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Mix thoroughly to dissolve sugar and ensure even coating.
Transfer mixture to a preheated cooking appliance basket set to 340°F.
Cook for 16 minutes, stirring every 5-6 minutes to ensure even caramelization and prevent scorching.
tip: Frequent agitation is critical. Brown sugar and balsamic vinegar are prone to rapid darkening under static heat conditions.

title: Balsamic Glazed Brussels Sprouts (Sweet, Sour & Crispy in 12 Mins)
ingredients: 14 oz Brussels sprouts, cleaned and halved
1.3 tbsp balsamic glaze or thick balsamic vinegar
description: No more mushy, unpleasant Brussels sprouts! In just 12 minutes, hot air makes them crispy outside and tender inside, while the honey balsamic glaze adds a sweet-sour note that wins over even the skeptics.
instructions: Combine halved Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, and pepper, ensuring even coating.
Distribute sprouts in a single layer within the cooking basket. Set appliance temperature to 375°F.
Cook for 10 minutes, agitating contents midway through to promote uniform browning.
Whisk balsamic glaze and honey in a small vessel.
After 10 minutes, apply glaze to sprouts, agitate to coat, and continue cooking for an additional 2 minutes for caramelization.
tip: Incorporate honey or sugar-based sauces exclusively during the terminal stages of cooking to facilitate a glossy finish and mitigate thermal degradation.

title: Confit Cherry Tomatoes (Flavor Candies in the Air Fryer)
ingredients: 14 oz cherry or datterino tomatoes, washed
0.7 fl oz extra virgin olive oil
Salt, pepper, and 1 whole smashed garlic clove
description: Get super sweet, concentrated cherry tomatoes in half the time of an oven. Gentle cooking at 285°F for 40 minutes turns them into true flavor 'candies', perfect for gourmet bruschetta or pasta.
instructions: Precisely halve all tomatoes and combine with the whole smashed garlic clove in a mixing vessel.
Dress the tomatoes with extra virgin olive oil, granulated sugar, dried oregano, salt, and pepper, ensuring uniform, gentle coating.
Line the base of the air fryer basket with perforated parchment paper. Arrange tomato halves with the cut surface oriented upward.
Initiate the cooking process at 285°F (140°C) for a continuous duration of 40 minutes to facilitate dehydration and caramelization.
Upon completion, carefully extract the tomatoes, remove and discard the garlic, and proceed with storage or immediate service on toasted bread.
tip: Orienting the tomato halves with the cut side facing upward mitigates juice loss, thereby concentrating flavor within the epidermal structure.

title: Fluffy Veggie Frittata (Light & Stress-Free in 15 Mins)
ingredients: 3.5 oz of mixed vegetables, sautéed or blanched (zucchini, peas, spinach)
description: Goodbye greasy pans and smoke in the kitchen! Discover how to make a tall, fluffy, and perfectly golden frittata thanks to convection cooking in 15 minutes. The ideal solution for a quick, protein-packed dinner.
instructions: Combine eggs, milk, cheese, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Whisk until thoroughly incorporated and slightly aerated.
Incorporate pre-cooked and well-drained vegetables into the egg mixture.
Lightly coat a small non-stick or silicone pan, suitable for an air fryer basket, with cooking spray.
Transfer the egg mixture to the prepared pan. Place the pan into the air fryer basket, preheated to 320°F.
Cook for approximately 15 minutes, or until the center is firm and the surface is visibly risen and golden brown.
tip: To prevent a watery consistency, ensure all added vegetables are thoroughly cooked and completely drained of excess moisture prior to incorporation.

title: Halloumi Skewers (The Cheese That Doesn't Melt)
ingredients: 7 oz Halloumi cheese, cut into large cubes
Half a red onion, cut into wedges
0.7 fl oz olive oil, oregano, and black pepper
description: Have you ever tried grilled cheese that 'crunches'? Halloumi in the air fryer becomes golden and crispy outside without melting, creating a super tasty vegetarian skewer in just 12 minutes.
instructions: Combine cheese cubes, zucchini, cherry tomatoes, and onion in a bowl. Dress with olive oil, oregano, and black pepper. Omit salt due to the inherent salinity of halloumi.
Thread ingredients alternately onto long wooden skewers suitable for the cooking appliance.
Arrange skewers on the appliance rack, preheated to 375°F (190°C).
Cook for 12 minutes, rotating skewers midway through the cooking cycle using tongs.
Remove from the appliance upon observation of golden-brown charring on the cheese.
tip: When utilizing wooden or bamboo skewers, soak them in cold water for 10 minutes prior to food assembly to mitigate combustion during cooking.

title: Potato and Provola Bake (Smoky Stringy Heart)
ingredients: 14 oz boiled and coarsely mashed potatoes
1 oz grated Parmesan cheese and 0.7 oz melted butter
Breadcrumbs for dusting, salt and nutmeg
description: The ultimate comfort food: a soft potato bake with a breadcrumb crust and a heart of smoked provola that stretches at the first cut. The air fryer ensures a perfect gratin in 25 minutes.
instructions: Combine the lukewarm mashed potatoes with the egg, melted butter, Parmesan, salt, and nutmeg.
Incorporate the diced provola into the mixture, ensuring even distribution.
Grease an appropriate baking dish and dust the base with breadcrumbs.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared dish, leveling the surface. Sprinkle generously with breadcrumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 340°F for 25 minutes, until the surface is firm, golden, and crisp.
tip: Utilize yellow-fleshed or starchy potato varieties. Ensure potatoes are cooled prior to egg incorporation to prevent premature coagulation.

title: Toasted Edamame (Sesame Protein Snack in 10 Mins)
ingredients: 8.8 oz frozen edamame (soybeans in the pod)
0.34 fl oz sesame or olive oil
0.07 oz garlic powder and a pinch of red pepper flakes
description: Forget boiled, bland edamame! By air-toasting them with sesame oil and chili, you'll get a protein-packed, 'crunchy' snack ready in 10 minutes. The healthy finger food that is totally addictive.
instructions: Place frozen edamame pods directly into the cooking basket. Process at 375°F (190°C) for 4 minutes to eliminate moisture and ice.
Remove the basket and transfer the heated pods to a mixing bowl.
Combine thoroughly with sesame oil, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, and salt flakes.
Return the seasoned pods to the cooking basket and continue processing for an additional 6 minutes.
Serve immediately. Consume beans directly from the pod.
tip: Applying seasoning post-initial 4-minute thawing phase prevents spice displacement due to melted ice accumulation at the base of the cooking apparatus.

title: Crispy Paprika Chickpeas (The Addictive Snack)
ingredients: 0.14 oz smoked paprika and 0.07 oz ground cumin
description: Swap potato chips for these flavor 'pearls'! Air-roasted chickpeas with smoked paprika: they become super crispy outside and soft inside in just 15 minutes. The ultimate fit snack.
instructions: Drain the chickpeas from their liquid and rinse them thoroughly under running water.
Transfer chickpeas to a clean kitchen towel and pat dry. Remove any loose skins.
In a bowl, coat chickpeas with olive oil.
Roast at 400°F for 15 minutes, agitating the cooking vessel every 5 minutes.
Upon completion of roasting, transfer chickpeas to a bowl and immediately combine with the paprika, cumin, and salt mixture.
tip: Thorough dehydration of the chickpeas prior to oil application is critical for achieving the desired crisp texture, preventing a soft consistency.

title: Parmesan Zucchini Chips (Crispy in 18 Minutes)
ingredients: Salt and a pinch of white pepper
description: Craving chips but on a diet? These Parmesan zucchini rounds are the perfect solution. Hot air dehydrates them, making them thin and crispy in 18 minutes. A delicious keto-friendly snack.
instructions: Slice zucchini into 2-millimeter rounds using a mandoline.
Blot slices thoroughly with paper towels to remove surface moisture.
Arrange slices in a single layer within the cooking basket, ensuring no overlap. Lightly coat with cooking spray.
Evenly sprinkle Parmigiano Reggiano, salt, and pepper over each round.
Cook at 320°F for 15-18 minutes. Monitor closely during the final minutes and remove once dry and golden.
tip: A mandoline is critical for achieving uniform slice thickness. Inconsistent slicing, typically resulting from knife use, leads to uneven cooking, characterized by burnt edges and undercooked centers.
